reviews.review_description: Game definitely uses AI voice acting which honestly isn’t a game breaker for me but the rest of the game seems made by AI as well. Training level makes no sense, Grenades show you pulling pin but then it’s still in the grenade but it explodes? Guns have unlimited ammo and no reloads. There’s an info box that never goes away attached to your off hand and always blocking your sight. Enemies are dumber than a box of rocks. Just avoid this honestly
